target.description: File the selected env is copied to. In a monorepo, relative to each app's dir.

example.description: Reference env file; every env must contain all of its keys. In a monorepo, relative to each app's dir.

envs.description: Shared environments: picking one switches every app that has it. Required for a single repo; in a monorepo each file is looked up inside every app's dir.

default.description: Title or file of the env to apply automatically when the target (e.g. .env) doesn't exist yet, such as after a fresh clone. Envs with "confirm": true are never applied automatically.

restart.description: Single repo: restarts the app. Monorepo: a command run from the root (e.g. "pnpm turbo dev"), with ports read from every app's env.

apps.description: Monorepo: apps whose env files are switched together. Omit for a single repo.

name.description: Name shown in messages and the terminal title. Defaults to the last folder of dir.

dir.description: App folder, relative to the workspace folder. Use "." to include env files at the repo root.

target.description: Overrides the top-level target for this app (relative to dir).

example.description: Overrides the top-level example for this app (relative to dir).

restart.description: Restarts this app in its own terminal; cwd defaults to dir.

envs.description: Per-app envs. An entry whose title matches a shared env overrides it (set "file": null to leave this app out of that env); any other entry is an env only this app has.

title.description: A shared env's title to override, or a new title for an app-only env.

file.description: Env file relative to the app's dir; null leaves this app out of the shared env.

description.description: Overrides the shared env's description, or describes an app-only env.

confirm.description: Overrides the shared env's confirm, or sets it for an app-only env.

restart.description: Restart the app in a dedicated terminal after switching. Stops it (Ctrl+C or closing the terminal), frees its ports, then runs the command.

enabled.description: Set to false to turn restarting off without removing the command. Defaults to true when a command is set.

command.description: Command that starts the app, run in the app terminal.

terminalName.description: Name of the app terminal. Defaults to "Env Switcher: <app or folder name>".

cwd.description: Working directory: relative to the workspace folder, or to the app's dir for a restart inside "apps". Defaults to that folder.

startIfNotRunning.description: Start the command when the app terminal isn't open yet.

killPorts.description: Ports to free before starting the app. Each item is a port number or the name of an env key that holds one; keys are read from both the previous and the new env. Use [] to disable.

enumDescriptions: recreate on Windows, ctrlC on macOS/Linux
Send Ctrl+C to the app terminal and reuse it (keeps scrollback)
Close the app terminal (kills its process tree) and open a new one
mode.description: How the running app is stopped before restarting.

title.description: Name shown in the picker and status bar. Envs with the same title are switched together across apps. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: Short note shown under the title in the picker and in the status bar tooltip (e.g. which database or API it points to).

file.description: Env file: relative to the workspace folder, or to each app's dir in a monorepo.

confirm.description: Ask for confirmation before switching (e.g. production).
